sources.title: Wikipedia: Augustus
sources.description: Roman emperor from 27 BC to AD 14

notes.text: Augustus, also known as Octavian, was the founder of the Roman Empire and the first Roman emperor from 27 BC until his death in AD 14.
The reign of Augustus initiated an imperial cult and an era of imperial peace when the Roman world was largely free of armed conflict.
Augustus is remembered as a politician connected with Italy.
Augustus's recorded life dates place this profile around -63-14.
Augustus is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
